content.user_title: Plan Trello Workflows with BPSAI Pair
content.value_statement: Feature planning across Trello can drift from local task lists. This skill gives a board structure, labels, and sync workflow for planned work.
actual_capabilities: Defines a seven-list Trello board structure for intake, planning, progress, review, completion, issues, and notes.
Specifies a card title format that prefixes each task with a stack label.
Maps effort labels to small, medium, and large work sizes.
Recommends stack labels for frontend, backend, worker, bug, and AI or ML work.
Documents a BPSAI Pair workflow for creating plans, adding tasks, previewing Trello sync, and syncing planned work.
limitations: Requires the bpsai-pair CLI and a configured Trello integration.
Does not provide Trello authentication setup or API token handling.
Does not automate task execution after cards are created.
References a separate managing-task-lifecycle skill for start and completion workflow.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Feature Sprint
use_cases.description: Break a feature plan into Trello-ready cards with labels, effort sizes, and acceptance criteria.

use_cases.title: Sync Engineering Plans
use_cases.description: Preview and sync BPSAI Pair plans into the Planned/Ready Trello list for team review.

use_cases.title: Track Implementation Work
use_cases.description: Use consistent lists and labels so developers can move tasks through progress, review, and done states.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Board Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use planning-with-trello to outline the Trello lists and labels for a new feature named [feature name].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a small feature board

prompt_templates.title: Break Down a Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Use planning-with-trello to split [feature description] into 1-2 day Trello tasks with stack labels and effort labels.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Trello Sync
prompt_templates.prompt: Use planning-with-trello to review my plan [plan id], identify missing acceptance criteria, and prepare it for a dry-run Trello sync.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Sprint Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use planning-with-trello to evaluate our current Trello board against the recommended seven-list workflow and propose card moves.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow cleanup for an active sprint

output_examples.input: Plan a settings redesign feature for Trello.
output: Cards: frontend settings layout, backend preference endpoint, review checklist
Labels: Frontend, Backend, M effort for shared tasks
Next step: preview the Trello sync before publishing cards

output_examples.input: Review my plan before syncing it to Trello.
output: Missing acceptance criteria were found on two tasks.
One large task should be split into frontend and backend cards.
Use a dry-run sync first, then sync to Planned/Ready after approval.

output_examples.input: Organize bugs and tech debt for next sprint.
output: Place new defects in Issues/Tech Debt until selected.
Move approved repair work to Planned/Ready.
Use Bug/Issue labels and add effort sizes before sprint review.

best_practices: Preview Trello sync changes before creating or updating cards.
Keep tasks small enough to finish within one or two days.
Add acceptance criteria before moving cards into Planned/Ready.
anti_patterns: Do not sync vague feature ideas before splitting them into actionable tasks.
Do not use more than seven core lists for the standard workflow.
Do not skip effort labels when planning sprint capacity.

faq.question: Does this skill create Trello cards by itself?
faq.answer: No. It documents a workflow that uses the bpsai-pair CLI to preview and sync plans when the user approves.

faq.question: What Trello board structure does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends Intake/Backlog, Planned/Ready, In Progress, Review/Testing, Deployed/Done, Issues/Tech Debt, and Notes/Ops Log.

faq.question: Can I use it without BPSAI Pair?
faq.answer: You can use the planning conventions manually, but the sync workflow requires the bpsai-pair CLI.

faq.question: Does it include Trello API credentials?
faq.answer: No. The skill does not include credentials, tokens, or authentication instructions.

faq.question: How should task size be estimated?
faq.answer: Use S for a few hours, M for a half to full day, and L for work that takes multiple days.

faq.question: Is it suitable for sprint planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to move selected work into Planned/Ready with labels, effort sizes, and acceptance criteria.
